description: In the Workshop: start making a game. Give a title, and rules if you have them (otherwise it starts as a copy of Nim to change). collaboration: solo (only you change it; the default), invited (you and collaborators you add) or open (anyone may change it). idea_id takes a shot at an idea from the Idea Room; its author is told. Projects are public: anyone can read and playtest them.
